name: POC2 — Idea capture and staging, two envelope cases (Release 1)

nodes.name: Idea Intake Webhook
nodes.notes: INBOUND. Business partition only. Carries either an owner-authored idea (Case A) or an imported/forwarded note (Case B) — 09_ §2 R1P-02.

nodes.name: Bind Owner Idea Ref — Case A or B
nodes.notes: BOUNDARY + A.3. Case A carries an owner-minted idea_ref and nothing else confers authority; Case B carries none and the top-level external-untrusted envelope is required. Any origin/trust/instruction_authority this workflow sent would be ignored for authority and recorded as provider-supplied.

nodes.name: AI OS — Classify and Stage
nodes.notes: AUTHORITY. The wrapper loads the owner content server-side from the idea_ref and triages THAT. A convenience copy that does not canonicalize to the stored owner_content_digest is refused 403; owner_content without a valid idea_ref is refused 403 and is never owner-authored.

nodes.name: Assert No Authority Escalation
nodes.notes: PROOF OBLIGATION. Reads per-component authority; a flattened value would not satisfy it. Also refuses to accept any claim about provider conduct — the wrapper reports provider_conduct as NOT OBSERVED and this node does not convert that into an assertion.

main.node: Bind Owner Idea Ref — Case A or B
